observations: Large office printer/copier wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'Fancy' is visible on a sticker on the front panel.
The unit has a white cabinet with three drawers.
The machine is positioned in a warehouse or shop environment.
A watermark 'KENDO ENTERPRISES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The brand 'Fancy' is visible on the front panel, but the model number is not legible in the photo.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on and the paper tray being loaded.

risks.risk: The toner cartridge may be empty or near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner level indicator on the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: as having a missing toner cartridge

risks.risk: The internal drum may be contaminated or worn.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge being removed from the machine.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge level indicator.
Photo of the toner cartridge being removed from the machine.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
